steps.hint: Turn your head to the far left. COMMS (communications with mission control) is there; look at it until the gaze ring fills.
POWER is ahead, slightly left. It feeds power to every system in the cabin; look at it until the gaze ring fills.
LIFE SUPPORT is ahead, slightly right. It keeps cabin air and temperature safe; look at it until the gaze ring fills.
Turn your head to the far right. STOWAGE is where tools are kept; look at it until the gaze ring fills.

steps.instruction: Open the CHECKLIST on the CREW DISPLAY.
steps.hint: CHECKLIST is the tab on the CREW DISPLAY, above the panels. A checklist lists every step of a task in order.
